description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo. The pin is now a release tag rather than a sha: petralabx/skills tags each merge to main with v<manifest.version>, so v1.4.1 is readable, immutable, and resolves to exactly one commit. v1.4.1 carries the 69-skill plx-engineering-core bundle (v1.4.0 imported the remaining operator-laptop skills, 30 added and none removed), the v1.3.2 description parity hardening, and two skill fixes that landed after the old sha pin and were therefore invisible to agents. manifest.gitRef no longer exists: a manifest cannot name the commit that contains it, so the stamp was stale by construction, and PLX_MC preferring it over the pin nearly served the 39-skill v1.3.1 tree under a v1.4.0 pin. Provenance now comes from the ref actually fetched. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
